notes: Optical atomic clock comparison (Yb+ E3/E2 and Yb+ E3/Sr) constraining oscillations of the fine-structure constant, i.e. scalar coupling d_e of ultralight dark matter to photons over mass range ~1e-24 to 1e-17 eV. The paper presents the exclusion only in a plot (Fig. 4) without a numerical table; data points here are approximate order-of-magnitude estimates read from the described exclusion. Density assumed 0.4 GeV/cm^3. A factor-of-3 rescaling for stochastic fluctuations was applied by authors.
